words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell of rain on dry soil
words.sentence1: The sudden summer shower released a heavy scent of petrichor throughout the garden. (The sudden summer shower released a heavy scent of petrichor throughout the garden.)
words.sentence2: She walked outside just to inhale the fresh petrichor after the long drought. (She walked outside just to inhale the fresh petrichor after the long drought.)

words.translation: The time spent chatting after a meal
words.sentence1: Tuvimos una larga sobremesa después de la cena familiar. (We had a long conversation after the family dinner.)
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es mi parte favorita de comer en España. (The time spent chatting after a meal is my favorite part of eating in Spain.)

words.translation: Lasting for a very short time
words.sentence1: La beauté d'un coucher de soleil est souvent éphémère. (The beauty of a sunset is often ephemeral.)
words.sentence2: Nous avons partagé un moment éphémère de joie pure sur la plage. (We shared a fleeting moment of pure joy on the beach.)

words.sentence1: Wenn ich den Ozean sehe, packt mich immer das Fernweh. (When I see the ocean, I am always seized by a longing for far-off places.)
words.sentence2: Sein tiefes Fernweh trieb ihn dazu, die Welt zu bereisen. (His deep longing for far-off places drove him to travel the world.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees
words.sentence1: 木漏れ日の中で本を読むのが好きです。 (I like reading a book in the sunlight filtering through the leaves.)
words.sentence2: 森の中の静かな木漏れ日はとても美しい。 (The quiet sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest is very beautiful.)

words.translation: To rest in the shade during the hottest part of the day
words.sentence1: Amiamo meriggiare sotto i pini durante l'estate. (We love to rest in the shade under the pine trees during the summer.)
words.sentence2: Il cane cercava un posto per meriggiare lontano dal sole. (The dog was looking for a place to rest in the shade away from the sun.)

words.sentence1: 月光下的景色显得格外朦胧。 (The scenery under the moonlight appears particularly hazy.)
words.sentence2: 她在朦胧的灯光下写了一封信。 (She wrote a letter under the dim, hazy light.)

words.translation: A short, deep sleep from which one is awakened
words.sentence1: 잠시 그루잠을 자고 일어났더니 몸이 한결 가벼워졌다. (I woke up after a short, deep sleep and felt much lighter.)
words.sentence2: 오후의 따스한 햇살 속에서 그루잠에 빠졌다. (I fell into a short, deep sleep amidst the warm afternoon sun.)

words.sentence1: សូមឱ្យអ្នកទទួលបានសិរីសួស្តីក្នុងថ្ងៃនេះ។ (May you receive glory and happiness this day.)
words.sentence2: នាងមានសិរីរុងរឿងដែលធ្វើឱ្យគ្រប់គ្នាសរសើរ។ (She possesses a splendor that makes everyone admire her.)

words.translation: To wander aimlessly or be in a daydream
words.sentence1: Hy hou daarvan om in die berge te dwaal. (He loves to wander aimlessly in the mountains.)
words.sentence2: My gedagtes dwaal dikwels na my kinderdae. (My thoughts often wander to my childhood days.)
